#indent_newline:6 $BULLET_WITH_TAB$#bold 1+#! disobedient: Minor troubles — [herd|E] losses, defecting [courtiers|E], lost [prestige_levels|E], or [tributaries|E] breaking free.#!

#indent_newline:6 $BULLET_WITH_TAB$#bold 2+#! disobedient: Significant disorder — large [herd|E] losses, land loss, lost [gold|E], or major [legitimacy|E] hits.#!

#indent_newline:6 $BULLET_WITH_TAB$#bold Half or more#! disobedient: Greater turmoil — enormous [herd|E] loss, the [realm|E] splitting in half, or even the [realm|E] dissolving completely.#!

#indent_newline:6 $BULLET_WITH_TAB$#bold Один и более#!: небольшие проблемы — потеря [Concept('herd', 'стад')|E], бегство [Concept('courtiers', 'придворных')|E], потеря [Concept('prestige_levels', 'уровней репутации')|E] или освобождение [Concept('tributaries', 'данников')|E].#!
